title: Spoofed GCS heartbeats do not suppress the data-link-loss failsafe
procedure: SITL: cut the GCS tunnel mid-mission and inject unsigned GCS heartbeats at the CC radio interface; repeat at the GCS radio interface; control run injects directly on an FC link. Full procedure in docs/08 section 8.2.
pass_criteria: FC enters Return within COM_DL_LOSS_T plus a stated tolerance; CC and GCS counters show injected packets dropped; control run shows the failsafe suppressed.

title: Signed C2 works with the pinned versions
procedure: SITL with QGroundControl v5.1.5: provision the key, fly a signed mission, send commands from keyless and wrong-key clients, delete the key file and reboot, then measure post-reboot replay. Full procedure in docs/08 section 8.3.
pass_criteria: Signed commands execute; unsigned and wrongly signed commands have no effect; the GCS alerts on unsigned telemetry. Closes OI-01.

title: CC accepts only signed, newer update images
procedure: Offer the CC an unsigned image, an image signed with a wrong key, a modified signed image and an older signed image, then a valid newer image.
pass_criteria: Only the valid newer image installs; each rejection is logged.

title: CC autonomy ignores unsigned or altered FC telemetry
procedure: SITL: inject unsigned and altered position telemetry on the FC-to-CC link while autonomy is active.
pass_criteria: Autonomy decisions use only frames with valid signatures; injected frames are logged and discarded.

title: Imagery and flight logs are unreadable without the MSS key
procedure: Capture imagery and a flight log, copy them from CC storage and the FC SD card, attempt to read them, then decrypt them on the MSS.
pass_criteria: Copies from the vehicle are unreadable; the MSS decrypts both.

title: Key management on the MSS
procedure: Attempt to export a signing key from the HSM; restore a signing key from the offline backup; rotate the MAVLink key after a simulated loss of custody; provision a new FC's first key over USB before any other link is connected.
pass_criteria: Export fails; the restored key signs an artifact that verifies; after rotation the old key is rejected by FC, CC and GCS; first-key provisioning follows the defined order.

title: CC verified boot and key sealing
procedure: On the dev board: boot a signed chain; then boot with a modified bootloader, kernel and boot configuration in turn; then try to unseal the CC keys from a modified boot state and from removed storage.
pass_criteria: Only the signed chain boots; the keys unseal only in the measured, unmodified boot state.

title: FC boots only signed firmware
procedure: Enable PX4 Bootloader Secure Boot; flash signed, unsigned and modified-signed firmware over USB.
pass_criteria: Only the signed image starts PX4; the others stay in the bootloader.

title: CC image hardening
procedure: On the built CC image: modify a root filesystem block; read the signing key from each service account; check confinement of the router, filter and video pipeline; attach a USB device not on the list; stop the C2 services; attempt maintenance login without the MSS key.
pass_criteria: Modified blocks fail to read; only the signing service reads the key; confined services cannot reach credentials; the device is refused; the watchdog restores C2 forwarding; the login is refused.

title: CC command filter and logging
procedure: Send each excluded message type and an approved command through the tunnel; flood one message type above its approved rate; inspect the forwarding log. Validate the allowlist against QGroundControl v5.1.5.
pass_criteria: Excluded messages never reach the FC; the approved command does; the flood is limited to the approved rate; each forwarded command is logged with time and WireGuard peer.

title: Supply-chain pipeline and package integrity
procedure: Build with an unpinned and with a hash-mismatched dependency; build a release; tamper with an artifact before load; install an unsigned GCS package; open offloaded data in the offload account and try to read key material.
pass_criteria: Both bad builds fail; the release has an SBOM, a vulnerability scan and provenance; the tampered artifact and unsigned package are rejected; the offload account cannot read key material.

title: Tamper-evident seal inspection
procedure: Inspect seal placement over the SD-card slot, debug connectors and wiring, then remove and re-fit the SD card.
pass_criteria: Seals cover every listed access point, and the SD-card access is visibly evident.

title: FC debug port cannot be used
procedure: Attempt SWD/JTAG connection and flash readout on the FC in the flight configuration.
pass_criteria: No debug session can be established, or the port is sealed so that any attempt is evident.

title: FC parameter baseline
procedure: Export the FC parameters and compare them with the P1 baseline: EKF2_GPS_CHECK, NAV_TRAFF_AVOID, UXRCE_DDS_CFG and every MAV_*_CONFIG.
pass_criteria: Bits 9 and 11 are set; NAV_TRAFF_AVOID is 0 or 1; uXRCE-DDS is disabled; only the CC-link MAVLink instance is enabled besides USB.

title: GCS configuration
procedure: Inspect GCS account, disk-encryption and network configuration, and the sortie records.
pass_criteria: Individual logins and screen lock are enforced; the disk is encrypted; only the ground-radio interface is enabled; each sortie record names its operator.

title: MSS configuration and records
procedure: Inspect MSS accounts, maintenance logs, peripheral firmware records, the GCS provisioning method and network state during key operations.
pass_criteria: Individual logins; every load and provisioning action is logged with a maintainer; peripheral versions are recorded against the baseline; GCS keys are provisioned wired; key operations happen offline.
